description: View one or all Active Decisions with full bodies. Use when you need to read the complete reasoning and evidence behind a specific AD before running strategy_change.

ad_id.description: Specific AD to fetch (e.g. "AD-12"). Omit to list all active decisions with full bodies.

fields.description: Optional sparse-field projection — comma-separated field names, e.g. "title,confidence". Returns a compact table of ONLY those fields (id is always included) instead of full AD bodies, which is far cheaper on session context when you just need the index. Allowed: id, title, confidence, superseded, supersededBy, decisionType, resolutionState, proposedBy, resolvedBy, body. An unknown name is an error.

limit.description: Max decisions to return. Omit to return all.

meta.description: Append a {total, filtered, returned, limit, offset} envelope so you can tell a truncated result from a complete one. Default false.

offset.description: Skip the first N decisions (pagination). Default 0.

name: ad_view
